module: Data manager of the Tree Spline tool: holds the list of tree splines (treeSplines) and the id -> index table (splineMap), creates/deletes/copies/splits splines, handles serialization (Lua reload and JSON session files), undo/redo, the links with the Master Spline and the rebuild of dirty splines (geometry then replanting via editor/treeSpline/populate). Used by editor/treeSpline.lua and by the shared tools (splineInput, session).
notes: Each spline carries: name, id (UUID), isDirty, isLoop, isEnabled (false = locked), isConformToTerrain (always true), isLink/linkId, avoidInfrastructure, nodes/widths/nmls, divPoints/divWidths/tangents/binormals/normals/discMap, items/count (Forest instances, runtime only) and the foliage parameters (class, spacingM, posVariance, scaleVariance, alignToNormal, slopeMaxDeg, seed, species, speciesWeights).
Foliage default values: posVariance 0.25, slopeMaxDeg 89, the rest comes from scatter.getDefaultDistribution(); a single species is checked by default so that the spline plants.
A linked spline (isLink) takes its geometry from the Master Spline; its terrain conformity flag is deliberately ignored.

getToolPrefixStr.desc: Returns the tool's name prefix (used to name splines and identify the type in the Master Spline).

getEditModeKey.desc: Returns the tool's edit mode key.

getTreeSplines.desc: Returns the list (live, not copied) of tree splines.

getSplineMap.desc: Returns the id -> index table of the splines.

getFoliageParamDefaults.desc: Default numeric distribution values for a new spline (no scenetree access, safe at module load).

returns.desc: class, spacingM, posVariance, scaleVariance, alignToNormal, slopeMaxDeg, seed.

makeFoliageDefaults.desc: Builds the default foliage distribution of a new spline: the numeric values plus one checked species (species) with its weight 1.0 (speciesWeights).

addNewTreeSpline.desc: Adds a new empty spline (unique name, UUID Engine.generateUUID, isConformToTerrain = true); the user then places its nodes by clicking on the terrain.

removeTreeSpline.desc: Deletes the spline at the given index and removes its planted trees. No effect if the index is invalid.

removeAllTreeSplines.desc: Deletes all splines (and their trees). Without isIncludeDisabled, only active, non-linked splines are deleted.

isIncludeDisabled.desc: True to include locked or linked splines.

deepCopyTreeSpline.desc: Deep copy of a spline, without the derived geometry or the runtime handles (rebuilt from the nodes and parameters).

deepCopyTreeSplineState.desc: Deep copy of the whole list (for cross-spline undo/redo).

splitTreeSpline.desc: Cuts the selected spline in two at the chosen node (open splines), or unrolls a loop in place. Both halves inherit the foliage parameters and the conformity setting.

setTreeSpline.desc: Replaces a spline's record (undo path of object selection in splineInput).

setTreeSplines.desc: Replaces the whole list of splines (cross-spline undo/redo).

singleSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes the edit of a single spline (editor history callback).

singleSplineEditRedo.desc: Redoes the edit of a single spline (history callback).

transSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes a cross-spline edit (add, delete, reorder across the whole list).

copyTreeSplineProfile.desc: Copies the profile (foliage parameters only, not the geometry); callback required by splineInput.

pasteTreeSplineProfile.desc: Applies a foliage profile to a spline; the geometry stays unchanged.

serializeTreeSpline.desc: Serializes a spline (whitelist of primary fields, without derived geometry) into an encoded blob, for persistence across Lua reload.

serializeTreeSplineToTable.desc: Plain portable table for a session file (toolUtilities/session): decodes the blob from serializeTreeSpline; jsonWriteFile flattens the vec3 nodes.

deserializeTreeSpline.desc: Rebuilds a spline from an encoded blob (string) or a JSON table. Resets the derived tables, marks the spline dirty, rehydrates the vec3 (nodes, nmls) and takes back the kept trees (keptObjects) via pop.adopt.

data.desc: Editor blob or table from a session file.

recomputeIdMap.desc: Recomputes the id -> index table; called by the session helper after a load that adds splines.

getState.desc: Full snapshot (all splines) as plain data, for onSerialize.

setState.desc: Restores the whole list from a snapshot (deletes everything first); the splines are marked dirty and replanted.

updateDirtyTreeSplines.desc: Rebuilds the geometry and replants dirty splines; may be called every frame. Reports the edit to the session (session.markEdited).

getCurrentTreeSplineList.desc: List of active splines as {name, id, type} for the link with the Master Spline.

isLinked.desc: Tells whether the spline with the given identifier is linked to a Master Spline.

setLink.desc: Links or unlinks the spline to a Master Spline group (linkId), removes its trees and marks it dirty.

updateLinkedTreeSpline.desc: Updates a linked spline with the geometry pushed by the Master Spline (nodes, widths, normals, loop); empties the derived geometry and the trees if fewer than 2 points. The isConformToTerrain parameter is ignored.

removeLinkedTreeSpline.desc: Deletes a linked spline by id (called when a Master Spline layer is removed).

unlinkAll.desc: Unlinks all linked splines and marks them dirty.
